name: Kana
source:
A new cast member.

She approached Haito, enveloped in despair after being fired from his job, and guided him to Bunny Garden.

She has an innocent and bright personality, treating everyone with kindness. Her untroubled smile provides comfort to customers. Despite her father's objections, she moved to Tokyo to pursue a certain dream.

[From the [url=https://qureate.co.jp/bunnygarden/en/]official website[/url]]
